name: delulu-talks-editor
description: Local R2T2 dictation and previewed Qwen rewriting through the running Delulu desktop app

deluluTalks.connectionFile.description: Absolute path to automation/connection.json shown in Delulu Settings. This file only discovers the loopback address; the extension requires its own scoped token.

deluluTalks.sendEditorContext.description: Send the document language and locally provided symbol names with an explicitly requested rewrite. No source bodies or window titles are collected.
